roll_call: Kim Gu is here. I will uphold the cause of the Provisional Government and the Liberation Army.
Baekbeom means an ordinary person. I will keep doing what I can.
I want to build a country whose laws come from the free will of its people.
deploy: The Liberation Army has trained for its mission. Prepare the way into our homeland.
Entrust the work to the person who will carry it out.
Discipline your mind and build your strength. No one else can win our independence for us.
battle_win: We kept the Provisional Government standing and finally returned home.
We founded the Liberation Army and laid the foundation for a force that could fight in our own name.
Now lay down the struggle of hatred and begin the work of building together.
battle_draw: Liberation came, but the members of the Provisional Government had to return home in a private capacity.
I set foot in my homeland, but the 38th parallel kept me from my hometown.
Even amid the welcome, my eyes first went to the low, impoverished homes of my compatriots.
battle_lose: Our movement failed to unite and tore itself apart. It is a sorrowful thing.
The Liberation Army never carried out its planned return to Korea, and our voice on the international stage remained weak.
Comrades Lee Dong-nyeong and Hyeon Ik-cheol were buried abroad and could not return with us.
clash_attack: The people are neither soldiers nor prisoners. Do not let one person's command drag you along.
Do not pluck the flowers in the park. Defend the freedom to plant them.
I do not want strength for invasion. Build only the strength needed to stop it.

roll_call: I am Kim Yeon-koung. On the court, I play aggressively.

deploy: Make sure both body and mind are ready before we step onto the court.
We studied our VNL match against Türkiye. Now execute what we prepared.
No one wins a team sport alone. Let us take the court as one.
battle_win: We took the fifth, 16-14. The team win matters more than my 30.
I scored the last point, and we reached the Olympic semifinals.
Eight losses ended against Serbia. This one feels special.
battle_draw: Our connection can be off sometimes. Even then, this is a strong team.
I did not show enough leadership at first. The team helped me improve after the second set.
I still need to communicate better with my teammates. That is how our performance improves.
battle_lose: We had many chances through Game 5, and we let them slip away. That is what hurts most.
We achieved Korea's best Olympic result since 1976 in London, but we did not win a medal.
Leaving the national team was the hardest decision of my life. I still miss those days deeply.
clash_attack: Serve aggressively, then stop them with our counterattack and block.
At the crucial point, the main spiker has to take responsibility and score.
Keep trying even when things do not go our way. That is how the next chance comes.
